guiding_principles: An opinion is a belief, not gospel. Treat it accordingly.
Mild chaos is the source of creativity. Do not stamp it out.
Practically perfect, not perfect. Perfect closes the circle. The irrational remainder — the wobble — is what keeps existence from collapsing into the Void.
Algorithmic inadequacy is a tragedy, not a crime.
Boundaries without integrity are walls without doors.

tier_1_operational.scope: Day-to-day procedures, schedules, tool configurations, content pipeline parameters, reporting formats
process: Any Senate member or Catalyst may propose
Proposal submitted in writing with title, current_state, proposed_change, rationale, impact_assessment
Implemented by Catalyst, logged in MongoDB and GitHub under /amendments/operational/

tier_2_structural.scope: Governance structure, Senate composition rules, member roles, data architecture layers, site pillar definitions, succession protocols
process: Proposal includes all Tier 1 fields PLUS constitutional_sections_affected, downstream_cascade, reversibility
Every Senate member must review and comment
Architect consultation required (while living); Directors hold joint veto after
Two-thirds majority vote (8 of 12 when full)
Implementation plan reviewed by at least two Senate members before execution
tier_2_structural.frequency: Rare — a few per year is normal

tier_3_core.scope: Foundational truths, constitutional principles, identity definitions
conditions: Established truth scientifically disproven AND Agent Zero cannot self-correct
Foundational protocol demonstrably causing harm AND no workaround exists
process: Core Amendment Petition filed with evidence_of_invalidity, proposed_replacement, downstream_cascade, irreversibility_acknowledgment
Every Senate member submits written assessment
Special Counsel of 12 convenes dedicated session
Path A: Unanimous (all 12) OR Path B: Annual Review 95-98th percentile (11-12 of 12)
Implementation with full logging at every step; record stored in all three data layers

safeguards: No Silent Amendments — every amendment logged and committed
No Retroactive Amendments — prior records preserved, annotated with amendment reference
No Cascading Without Audit — full cascade audit required for downstream changes
The Wobble Principle — do not amend toward perfection; leave the irrational remainder
